![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

When the thresholds file is missing or malformed, the threshold values default to `null`. In JavaScript, comparing a number to `null` using `>=` (e.g., `24 >= null`) evaluates to `true` because `null` is coerced to `0`. This causes the `acceptedThresholdMet` check to erroneously pass even when critical threshold configurations are missing, violating the fail-closed principle.

We should explicitly verify that each threshold value is a valid number before performing the comparison.

```suggestion
  const minEdges = thresholdValues.min_accepted_edges_for_calibration_success;
  const minQuestions = thresholdValues.min_accepted_questions_for_calibration_success;
  const reqCount = thresholdValues.accepted_count_required_for_rag_manifest;
  const acceptedThresholdMet =
    typeof minEdges === 'number' &&
    typeof minQuestions === 'number' &&
    typeof reqCount === 'number' &&
    promotionRun.summary.accepted_count >= minEdges &&
    acceptedQuestions >= minQuestions &&
    promotionRun.summary.accepted_count >= reqCount;
```

<summary>References</summary>

1. Ensure validation and check scripts handle missing or malformed critical artifacts gracefully without throwing unhandled exceptions. They should fail-closed by returning a failed validation status, a failure count, and diagnostic codes, backed by regression tests.
</details>

![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Similarly, if `max_candidate_only_ratio_for_rag_manifest` is `null` due to missing thresholds, the comparison `ratio <= null` will evaluate to `true` for a ratio of `0`, allowing the check to pass. We should explicitly verify that the threshold is a valid number.

```javascript
    typeof thresholdValues.max_candidate_only_ratio_for_rag_manifest === 'number' &&
    ragLiteHvyManifest.summary.candidate_only_ratio <=
      thresholdValues.max_candidate_only_ratio_for_rag_manifest
```

If the review load thresholds are `null` due to missing or malformed thresholds, the comparison `load <= null` will evaluate to `true` when the load is `0`, allowing the check to pass. We should explicitly verify that both thresholds are valid numbers.

```javascript
    typeof thresholdValues.max_review_required_per_question === 'number' &&
    typeof thresholdValues.max_review_required_ratio === 'number' &&
    reviewRequiredPerQuestion <= thresholdValues.max_review_required_per_question &&
    reviewRequiredRatio <= thresholdValues.max_review_required_ratio
```

![medium](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/medium-priority.svg)

Currently, the CLI only sets a non-zero exit code if the validation status is exactly `'fail'`. However, if the validation status is `'blocked'` (e.g., due to an active validator-backed blocker), the CLI will exit with `0`. This can allow blocked promotions to pass silently in CI/CD pipelines. We should exit with a non-zero code for any status other than `'pass'` to prevent proceeding with blocked runs.

```suggestion
  if (result.validatorResult.validator_status !== 'pass') {
    process.exitCode = 1;
  }
```

Fixed in 8d813fbea. The accepted-count gate now requires all three accepted thresholds to be finite numbers before comparing counts, so missing or malformed threshold artifacts fail closed instead of passing through null coercion.
Fixed in 8d813fbea. The CLI now exits non-zero for any validator_status other than pass, including blocked runs.
Fixed in 8d813fbea. The review-load gate now requires both max_review_required_per_question and max_review_required_ratio to be finite numbers before threshold comparisons.
Fixed in 8d813fbea. Added fail-closed regression coverage for missing and malformed threshold artifacts, including critical diagnostics plus failed/blocked validator checks for the affected gates.
Fixed in 8d813fbea. The RAG manifest candidate-only-ratio check now requires max_candidate_only_ratio_for_rag_manifest to be a finite number before applying the <= comparison.
